description: Scaffold the TypeScript Pi package and quality gates
notes: Created the single TypeScript ESM Pi package with local extension manifest, pi-cloud bin, Node 24/Pi 0.84 compatibility, build/check/test/pack scripts, README, license, and initial protocol/recommendation placeholders. npm run check, npm test, and serial npm run pack:smoke pass.

description: Define protocol contracts, validation, and error codes
notes: Added versioned client/worker frame contracts, task/session/Git/artifact/environment types, structured error codes, JSONL framing, protocol-version checks, and runtime validation for hello/pair/task/input frames. Protocol round-trip and malformed-input tests pass.
Added zh-CN/en catalogs, system-locale detection with explicit override and English fallback, structured parameter interpolation, and catalog parity/fallback tests.

description: Build Pi environment manifest and secret fingerprints
notes: Implemented Pi global/project resource scanning, package/provider manifests, platform compatibility warnings, SHA-256 helpers, redacted secret fingerprints, unchanged-secret detection, and manifest tests confirming secret values do not leak.

description: Implement deterministic Git snapshot and result helpers
notes: Implemented Git repository checks, deterministic tracked/selected-untracked snapshots, baseline hashes, safe baseline comparison, serialization/parsing, and round-trip tests covering modifications, untracked files, and mismatch refusal.

description: Implement Pi session export and native tail synthesis
notes: Implemented Pi-native session branch export, JSONL archive parsing/serialization, remote tail extraction, live-entry filtering, base/collision/orphan validation, atomic merged-session writing, and merge tests.

description: Add shared unit and round-trip tests
notes: Added shared protocol, i18n, environment, Git, and session unit/round-trip tests. npm run check and npm test pass with 14 tests.
